description: The pull requests merged and the commits between two releases, from the app's GitHub repo (linked on its GitHub card in Ploa): for a release, since the release of its platform before it; with no release, what the release branch has had since the live version (or else the last release that reached testers). Each PR comes with its title, author and description. Use it to write release notes from what people did rather than commit messages alone (the write_release_notes prompt).

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

releaseId.description: A release. Left out: the app's release branch since the live version.

name: ploa_release_changes
title: What's in a release
